description: This script manages and retrieves iOS development team IDs for code signing, sourcing data from Xcode preferences, profiles, and keychain, with fallback options and user prompts.

methods.name: detect_python
methods.description: Detects available Python interpreter among common options.

methods.name: append_team
methods.description: Adds a team ID, free status, and name to internal lists if not already present.

methods.name: load_teams_from_xcode_preferences
methods.description: Loads team IDs from Xcode's preferences plist.

methods.name: load_teams_from_legacy_defaults_key
methods.description: Loads team IDs from legacy UserDefaults key.

methods.name: load_teams_from_xcode_managed_profiles
methods.description: Loads team IDs from provisioning profiles stored on filesystem.

methods.name: has_xcode_account
methods.description: Checks if an Xcode account exists with developer IDs.
